description: Soft Kenyan fried dough triangles perfumed with ground cinnamon, a beloved coastal teatime snack.

steps.instruction: Mix flour, cinnamon, sugar and salt in a bowl. Add milk and knead into a soft dough.
Cover and rest for 15 minutes. Roll out and cut into triangles.
Fry in hot oil until golden brown, about 2–3 minutes per side. Drain and serve warm.

description: A warming Kenyan tea brewed with cinnamon, milk and sugar, enjoyed in homes and roadside cafes.

steps.instruction: Bring water and cinnamon stick to a boil and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add tea leaves, milk and sugar. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Strain into cups and serve hot.

description: A creamy Kenyan rice pudding scented with cinnamon, slow-cooked in milk and sweetened with sugar.

steps.instruction: Rinse rice and combine with milk in a pot.
Bring to a boil, then simmer on low heat for 25 minutes, stirring often, until rice is soft and creamy.
Stir in sugar and cinnamon. Serve warm or chilled.

serving_suggestion: Serve as a dessert or snack.

description: Chicken pieces simmered with cinnamon, onions and tomatoes, giving a warm, aromatic Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken in hot oil for 6–8 minutes.
Add chopped onion and cook until soft. Stir in cinnamon and chopped tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add salt and water, cover and simmer for 20 minutes until chicken is tender. Serve with rice.

description: Tender beef simmered with ground cumin, onions and tomatoes, a warmly spiced Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Boil beef until tender, about 30 minutes. Reserve broth.
Heat oil and sauté onions until golden. Add cumin and tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add beef and broth, simmer for 15 minutes. Season and serve with ugali.

description: Fragrant rice cooked with ground cumin and onions, a simple Kenyan side with a warm aroma.

steps.instruction: Rinse rice. Heat oil and sauté onion until soft.
Stir in cumin and rice. Add water and salt.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes until tender. Fluff and serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve with beef stew or grilled chicken.

description: Yellow lentils simmered with ground cumin, onions and tomatoes, a comforting Kenyan vegetarian stew.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion in oil until soft. Add cumin and tomatoes, cook until saucy.
Add lentils and water. Bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20–25 minutes until lentils are soft. Season and serve with rice.

description: Tilapia marinated with ground cumin, garlic and lemon, then grilled until golden and fragrant.

steps.instruction: Mix cumin, lemon juice, crushed garlic, oil and salt. Rub over scored tilapia and marinate for 10 minutes.
Grill over medium charcoal or in a hot pan for 6–7 minutes per side.
Serve hot with kachumbari.

description: Chicken pieces finished with fresh mint in a tomato sauce, a cooling Kenyan dish.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken in oil for 6–8 minutes. Remove.
Sauté onion until soft, add tomatoes and cook until saucy. Return chicken and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in chopped mint just before serving. Serve with rice.

description: A cooling Kenyan dip of yogurt, fresh mint, cucumber and a hint of garlic.

steps.instruction: Grate cucumber and squeeze out excess water.
Mix yogurt, cucumber, chopped mint, crushed garlic and salt.
Chill for 10 minutes and serve as a dip or side.

serving_suggestion: Serve with pilau or grilled meat.

description: A refreshing Kenyan tea infused with fresh mint leaves and lightly sweetened.

steps.instruction: Bring water to a boil and add tea leaves and mint leaves.
Simmer for 5 minutes. Add sugar and stir.
Strain and serve hot.

serving_suggestion: Serve after a meal as a digestif.

description: A fresh Kenyan tomato and red onion salad tossed with mint and lemon juice.

steps.instruction: Dice tomatoes and red onion. Chop mint.
Combine in a bowl and squeeze lemon juice over.
Add salt, toss gently and serve fresh.

serving_suggestion: Serve with nyama choma or pilau.

description: Fragrant rice cooked with fresh mint and onions, a light Kenyan side dish.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion in oil until soft. Add rice and stir.
Add water and salt. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in chopped mint, cover for 5 minutes and serve.

description: Chicken pieces cooked with paprika, onions and tomatoes for a smoky, warmly spiced Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken in oil for 6–8 minutes. Remove.
Sauté onion until soft. Add paprika and tomatoes, cook until saucy.
Return chicken, add water and salt, simmer for 20 minutes. Serve with rice.

description: Potato wedges tossed in paprika and oil, roasted until crisp and golden.

steps.instruction: Cut potatoes into wedges. Toss with oil, paprika and salt.
Spread on a baking tray and roast at 200°C for 25–30 minutes, turning once.
Serve hot as a snack or side.

description: Tilapia fillets rubbed with paprika and pan-fried until golden, a quick Kenyan fish dish.

steps.instruction: Rub fillets with paprika, salt and lemon juice.
Heat oil and fry fillets for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked.
Serve hot with rice or salad.

description: Beef cubes simmered in a paprika-spiced tomato gravy, a rich Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Boil beef until tender. Reserve broth.
Sauté onions until golden. Add paprika and tomatoes, cook until saucy.
Add beef and broth, simmer for 15 minutes. Serve with ugali.

description: Fluffy rice cooked with turmeric and onions, giving a golden colour and earthy flavour.

steps.instruction: Heat oil and sauté onion until soft. Stir in turmeric.
Add rice and stir to coat. Pour in water and salt.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Fluff and serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve with beef stew or grilled chicken.

description: Chicken pieces cooked with turmeric, onions and tomatoes, a golden Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Brown chicken in oil for 6–8 minutes. Remove.
Sauté onion until soft. Add turmeric and tomatoes, cook until saucy.
Return chicken, add water and salt, simmer for 20 minutes. Serve.

description: Yellow lentils simmered with turmeric, onions and tomatoes, a golden Kenyan vegetarian stew.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until soft. Add turmeric and tomatoes, cook until saucy.
Add lentils and water. Bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20–25 minutes until lentils are soft. Season and serve.

description: Tilapia fillets rubbed with turmeric and pan-fried until golden, a simple coastal Kenyan dish.

steps.instruction: Rub fillets with turmeric, salt and lemon juice.
Heat oil and fry fillets for 3–4 minutes per side until golden.
Serve hot with rice or ugali.

description: Kenya's beloved braised kale, cooked with onions and tomatoes until tender and flavourful.

steps.instruction: Wash kale, remove tough stalks and slice finely.
Heat oil and sauté onion until golden. Add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add kale and salt, cook for 5–7 minutes until tender but bright green. Serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve with ugali and a meat stew.

description: Kale and potatoes simmered together in a tomato-onion sauce, a hearty Kenyan side or main.

steps.instruction: Peel and cube potatoes. Sauté onion until golden, add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add potatoes and water, simmer for 15 minutes until almost tender.
Add chopped kale and salt, cook for 5 minutes. Serve hot.

description: Kale simmered in creamy coconut milk with onions, a coastal Kenyan side dish.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion in oil until soft. Add chopped kale and cook for 3 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk and add salt.
Simmer for 7–10 minutes until kale is tender. Serve with rice.

description: Kale sautéed with onions and scrambled eggs, a nutritious Kenyan breakfast.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion in oil until soft. Add chopped kale and cook for 3 minutes.
Beat eggs with salt and pour over the kale.
Scramble until eggs are set. Serve with chapati.

description: Kale and beans simmered in a tomato-onion sauce, a protein-rich Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until golden, add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add beans and cook for 5 minutes.
Add chopped kale and salt, cook for 5 minutes. Serve with ugali.

description: Whole sweet potatoes roasted until tender, served with lime and a hint of chilli.

steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 220°C. Prick sweet potatoes and place on a tray.
Roast for 45–50 minutes until fork-tender.
Split open, squeeze lime juice over and sprinkle with chilli and salt.

description: A traditional Luhya dish of boiled sweet potatoes mashed with cooked beans.

steps.instruction: Peel and boil sweet potatoes in salted water for 15–20 minutes until soft. Drain.
Add cooked beans and mash together until combined but slightly chunky.
Adjust salt and serve warm.

serving_suggestion: Serve on its own or with a light stew.

description: Sweet potato cubes simmered in a spiced coconut curry with onions and tomatoes.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until soft. Add curry powder and tomatoes, cook until saucy.
Add cubed sweet potato and coconut milk.
Simmer for 15–20 minutes until sweet potato is tender. Season and serve with rice.

description: A smooth, naturally sweet Kenyan porridge made from boiled sweet potatoes and millet flour.

steps.instruction: Peel and boil sweet potatoes in water for 10 minutes until soft.
Mash sweet potatoes. Mix millet flour with a little water and stir into the pot.
Cook for 8–10 minutes until thick. Sweeten if desired and serve warm.

description: Crispy fried sweet potato strips, a popular Kenyan snack with a natural sweetness.

steps.instruction: Peel and cut sweet potatoes into thin strips.
Heat oil in a deep pan and fry in batches until golden and crisp.
Drain, sprinkle with salt and serve hot.

serving_suggestion: Serve as a snack with kachumbari.

description: Small dried sardines cooked in a rich onion and tomato sauce, a classic Lake Victoria dish.

steps.instruction: Rinse omena and drain. Dry-fry for 2 minutes to remove moisture.
Heat oil and sauté onions until golden. Add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add omena and salt, simmer for 5–7 minutes. Serve with ugali.

description: Dried omena cooked with collard greens, onions and tomatoes, a nutritious Kenyan meal.

steps.instruction: Rinse omena. Sauté onion until golden, add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add omena and cook for 3 minutes.
Add sliced collard greens and salt, stir-fry for 5–7 minutes. Serve with ugali.

description: Dried omena simmered in a creamy coconut and tomato sauce, a coastal Kenyan variation.

steps.instruction: Rinse omena. Sauté onion until soft, add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add omena and coconut milk.
Simmer for 10–12 minutes until thick. Season and serve with rice or ugali.

description: Crispy omena stew served with hot ugali, a classic Kenyan meal from the lake region.

steps.instruction: Boil water and salt, gradually add maize flour and stir until firm. Shape ugali.
Rinse omena. Sauté onion until golden, add tomatoes and cook until saucy. Add omena and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve the omena stew with the hot ugali.

description: Omena simmered with beans in a tomato-onion sauce, a protein-rich Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Rinse omena. Sauté onion until golden, add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add beans and omena, stir to combine.
Simmer for 10 minutes, season and serve with ugali.

description: A traditional Kenyan one-pot dish of maize and beans cooked with onions, hearty and nutritious.

steps.instruction: Soak maize and beans overnight. Boil in water for 45–60 minutes until tender.
Sauté onions in oil until golden. Add cooked maize and beans.
Season with salt and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve hot.

description: Charred roasted maize on the cob, a ubiquitous Kenyan street snack seasoned with salt and lemon.

steps.instruction: Husk maize cobs and remove silk.
Roast over hot charcoal or on a grill, turning frequently, for 10–15 minutes until charred.
Sprinkle with salt and squeeze lemon juice over. Serve hot.

description: A hearty Kenyan stew of maize and beans cooked with tomatoes and onions.

steps.instruction: Soak maize and beans overnight. Boil in water for 45–60 minutes until tender.
Sauté onions until golden, add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add cooked maize and beans, season with salt and simmer for 10 minutes. Serve.

description: A sweet Kenyan porridge made from grated fresh maize and milk.

steps.instruction: Grate fresh maize kernels. Blend with a little water to a coarse paste.
Bring remaining water to a boil, add maize paste and cook for 15 minutes, stirring.
Add milk and sugar, simmer for 3 minutes and serve warm.

description: Fresh maize and pumpkin simmered in a tomato-onion sauce, a colourful Kenyan stew.

steps.instruction: Sauté onion until golden, add tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add maize kernels and cubed pumpkin, stir to coat.
Add salt and water, simmer for 20 minutes until pumpkin and maize are tender. Serve.

description: A smooth, fermented millet porridge enjoyed warm for breakfast across Kenya.

steps.instruction: Mix millet flour with 1 cup water to make a smooth paste.
Bring remaining water to a boil. Stir in the paste and salt.
Cook on low heat for 10–12 minutes, stirring, until thick. Sweeten and serve warm.

description: A nutritious Kenyan ugali made from millet flour, with a nutty flavour and firm texture.

steps.instruction: Bring water and salt to a boil in a heavy pot.
Gradually add millet flour while stirring continuously to prevent lumps.
Reduce heat and keep stirring for 8–10 minutes until firm. Shape and serve.

serving_suggestion: Serve with sukuma wiki or beef stew.

description: A warm Kalenjin porridge of millet flour stirred with sour milk, nourishing and slightly tangy.

steps.instruction: Mix millet flour with 1 cup water to form a smooth paste.
Bring remaining water to a boil, stir in paste and cook for 8–10 minutes until thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in sour milk. Serve warm.

description: A naturally sweet Kenyan porridge made with millet flour and mashed ripe banana.

steps.instruction: Mix millet flour with 1 cup water to form a paste. Mash bananas.
Bring remaining water to a boil, stir in millet paste and cook for 8 minutes.
Stir in mashed banana and sugar, simmer for 2 minutes and serve warm.

description: Soft Kenyan chapati made with a blend of millet and wheat flour, adding a nutty flavour.

steps.instruction: Mix millet flour, wheat flour and salt. Add water and knead into a soft dough. Rest for 30 minutes.
Divide into balls, roll thin, brush with oil, fold into a spiral and roll again.
Cook on a hot pan for 2–3 minutes per side, brushing with oil, until golden.

serving_suggestion: Serve with beef stew or beans.
